text:
natalie: Heads up — I'm kicking off a staggered deploy for API 2.3.0, runtime 5.1.1, router 1.8.0. Console will be pinned to 2026-03-20-01 for compatibility. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: shard-a -> shard-b -> global. Steps: 5%/25%/100% with 5m observation windows. Canary timeout 10m. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 1.5% OR p95 latency regresses >200ms from baseline.

alex: ping — does runtime 5.1.1 require new kernel flags for batching? I saw a note about kv-cache TTL change.

maria: Yes, runtime 5.1.1 enables continuous-batching opt by default. We set env `CONT_BATCH=auto` in the runtime job. KV-cache TTL isn't changing but eviction policy defaults to LRU; we flipped `kv_evict=max-age` earlier this week.

ravi: Router 1.8.0 introduces header passthrough for `x-rw-trace` — we've tested handshake but need to confirm session affinity doesn't break canary routing. @jin can you run the router smoke script against shard-a?

jin: running smoke now against shard-a (10m run). Command I used: `./scripts/healthcheck --target shard-a --routes /api/v1/generate` — results look green so far, no affinity drops.

ops-bot: reminder: maintenance window set in PagerDuty for 02:00-05:00 UTC. Auto-escalation suppressed for canary window.

natalie: Note on pinning: Console UI relies on /status v2 response shape, so pin console to 2026-03-20-01 to avoid race while API returns mixed shapes during canary. We'll unpin in final step.

alex: Ok. If canary fails on shard-b, what's rollback plan? Full rollback to runtime 5.0.4 and router 1.7.9, API to 2.2.8? Or do we do staggered rollback only on affected shard?

maria: Preference is targeted rollback per-shard unless we see API contract break. If it's latency-only on runtime, we can pin runtime back on that shard and continue. If 5xx spike across shards -> full cut.

ravi: Agree. We'll keep deploy bot configured with `rollback_on_global=true` toggle off by default. Ops will flip it if severity hits.

jin: quick data point from smoke: p95 generation latency on shard-a baseline 160ms -> canary 170ms (+6%). Under threshold. No 5xx.

deploy-bot: kicked canary to 5% on shard-a at 02:10 UTC. Observing.

natalie: Reminder to attach release notes to the rollout ticket: include model compat notes, kernel flag list, and the CLI commands for emergency rollback. I'll paste CLI snippets here when we hit 25%.

alex: Request: add a short metric to console panel showing `canary_p95_delta` so SRE can eyeball quickly. @maria can you add a temporary dashboard tile?

maria: On it — will add under /observability/release-windows.

ops-bot: alert rule `runtime_high_5xx_rate` set to `notify: on` during canary. Threshold matches rollback criteria.

natalie: At 02:35 UTC we'll advance to 25% if no alerts. If any single shard crosses criteria, we pause and triage; staging rollback command is `./deploy rollback --service runtime --version 5.0.4 --shard shard-a`.

ravi: Also double-check CDN cache invalidation for router header changes — otherwise clients might route weirdly. I'll run invalidation right before 25%.

jin: 02:28 — manual probe all routes OK. Starting 25% step now.

deploy-bot: advanced to 25% at 02:32 UTC. Observation window running.

maria: dashboard tile up, showing `canary_p95_delta` and `5xx_rate` per-shard.

alex: If we need to abort, what's the customer-facing comms plan?
natalie: Draft in #marketing: short blurb about transient errors and fast rollback. CC support and accounts. We'll only escalate external comms if outage >15min or data loss.

ops-bot: no alerts triggered so far.

deploy-bot: advanced to 100% at 03:05 UTC. Unpinning console in 5m.

natalie: Great — unpinning console now. Final checks: confirm feature flags and rollout notes updated. I'll update the ticket and add the rollback snippets. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team.

ravi: good run.

maria: nice and smooth.
